title: fix(cli): a config that fails to load is no longer reported as "Compile failed"
body:
Fixes #32439
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os dev` / `os start` / `os serve --dev` / `os environments bind --build` 在 `os compile` 子进程失败时的收尾行，以及 `os dev` 监听重编译的失败行，不再说 "Compile failed"，改为 "objectstack.config did not load or compile — the reason is printed above; fix it before …"。
- 为什么改：配置在加载时被拒（例如许可证或 KMS 拒绝启动）也走这一行，运维人员读到 "Compile failed" 会去找代码错误；按裁决 D 只改为中性措辞，不做分类。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案，不改退出码、错误码和子进程输出；若有脚本匹配旧文案 "Compile failed" 会不再命中；仓内唯一一处（sql-perf bench）已在本 PR 改为匹配新文案。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`（启动编译与监听重编译两处）、`packages/cli/src/commands/compile-child-failure-line.pin.test.ts`、`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 dev boot 一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/compile-child-failure-line.pin.test.ts src/commands/dev-watch-compile-refusal.pin.test.ts`，预期 14 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

When the `os compile` child exits non-zero, the parent sees only the exit status. A syntax error in the config, a refusal thrown while it loads, and a refusal that prints and calls `process.exit(1)` all reach the same branch. The closing line there said `Compile failed — fix errors above …`, which sent an operator whose boot was refused at config load looking for a code error.

Ruling-ref 6998194814, letter D (verbatim): "D. Neutral wording, no detection. The closing line printed when the `os compile` child exits non-zero stops asserting a code error. It says the config did not load or compile and that the reason is printed above."

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `dev.ts` boot compile | `Compile failed — fix errors above before starting dev server` | `objectstack.config did not load or compile — the reason is printed above; fix it before starting dev server` |
| `start.ts` | `… before starting the server` (+ `--artifact` hint) | same phrase, `fix it before starting the server`; hint unchanged |
| `serve.ts` dev boot | `✗ Compile failed — fix errors above before starting the dev server.` | `✗ RELATIVE_CONFIG did not load or compile — the reason is printed above; fix it before starting the dev server.` (the config path this boot compiled) |
| `environments/bind.ts` | `… before binding` | same phrase, `fix it before binding` |
| `dev.ts` watch recompile | `✗ compile failed (Nms)` | `✗ objectstack.config did not load or compile (Nms)`, compile output after it as before |

The watch recompile line is a fifth site the ruling's list did not name. It is printed on the same condition (the child exits non-zero) and made the same "compile failed" claim, so it is covered as the same closing line. It says nothing about "above", because its relayed output comes after it.

`objectstack.config` names the file family on purpose. `os compile` with no positional auto-detects `objectstack.config.{ts,js,mjs}`, so naming `.ts` would be false for the other two. `serve.ts` knows the actual path and prints it.

The one in-repo consumer that matched the old text, the boot-log check in `packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs` (~line 194), now matches `did not load or compile` and keeps its own `fixture compile failed` message. The area granted this as a file-surface addendum.

Not changed: exit statuses, error codes, the child's own output, and cloud. Per the ruling, a classifying fix (a new `os compile` exit status, a typed refusal code, cloud refusals that throw instead of exit) is out of scope here.

## Tests

- New `src/commands/compile-child-failure-line.pin.test.ts`: a source pin over the four boot sites, for the reason `child-env-source-loader.pin.test.ts` gives (driving these sites means spawning the built CLI). For each site it checks that exactly one code line carries the neutral phrase, that the line carries that site's tail, that it sits in a `status !== 0` branch, and that it says neither "compile error" nor "refused". For each file it checks that no code line says "compile failed".
- `dev-watch-compile-refusal.pin.test.ts` (the existing harness that drives the real `startWatchRecompile`) gains a top-level describe. Two fixtures exit 2 and 1, and for both the head line must say "objectstack.config did not load or compile" and must say none of "compile error", "refused", "compile failed". The file also gains 11 factory `vi.mock`s for dynamic loads that `check:test-source-alias`'s source reach finds through `dev.ts`, which the watch loop never calls (that gate judges an edited test file).
- `child-env-source-loader.pin.test.ts`: the quoted transcript in the comment now shows the new line.

Ablation (committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor counts and blob hashes verified on disk, restore checked with `git diff HEAD` empty):
1. `dev.ts` watch line set back to `✗ compile failed (${dt}ms)`: 3 tests fail (both new watch cases, plus the source pin's dev.ts "no code line still says compile failed"), and 11 pass.
2. `start.ts` line set back to the old literal: 2 tests fail (start.ts neutral-line and start.ts stale-line), and 6 pass.

These are vitest relative imports of `src/`, so no `dist/` is involved.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs` (~line 194) matched `text.includes('Compile failed')`, and this PR would have made that match dead. It was changed in this PR to the new phrase under the granted file-surface addendum (commit `c041c7fe`). The bench's own error message is unchanged.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` items[0].variants[6] quoted the old line. It now quotes the new dev.ts closing line under the granted file-surface addendum (commit `392fd9a2`); nothing else in that file changed.
- `CHANGELOG.md` entries quoting the old text are release-owned and were not edited.

## Verification
